paragraphs.text: MOVED to dsh-check-pack — https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-check-pack. This repository is a pointer/
backup; the old npm package @perrylink/dsh-checkers is deprecated.
> **Moved:** this project is now **dsh-check-pack**. This repository stays as a pointer/backup; new
work happens in the new home. Old npm packages `@perrylink/dsh-checkers` and `@perrylink/dsh-checker
s-suite` are deprecated; install `dsh-check-pack`.
# @perrylink/dsh-checkers-suite
> **Package name:** install `@perrylink/dsh-checkers` (the current shim). `@perrylink/dsh-checkers-s
uite` is a deprecated alias; it now points here.
One-command installer for the **53-plugin PerryLink compliance suite**.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
It installs every compliance plugin and inserts all 53 Cordis rows through one bundle layer.

**npm publication status:** the name is published from this repo under the
`@perrylink/dsh-checkers-

suite` name, but npm currently stages new package
versions for 2FA approval. Use the git channel abo

ve until that approval lands.
Each compliance plugin keeps its own npm name, rule pack, README, and

version; this package
is only the suite entry point.

**Scope:** China-domain document checks (trade, customs, bids, HSE, medical,
legal, government, manu

facturing). Every compliance plugin reports differences and never
makes a legal/medical/customs dete

rmination. See `checkers.json` for the exact
list and versions.

**Uninstall:** `dsh plugin --profile web remove @perrylink/dsh-checkers-suite` removes
the suite row

; remove individual compliance plugin packages separately if you installed
them directly.
Apache-2.0. Regenerate with `node build.mjs` after compliance plugin versions change.
